title: Which Harry Potter character are you? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Harry Potter character quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Harry, Hermione, Ron, Luna, Neville, Draco, Ginny or Dumbledore. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
h1: Which Harry Potter character are you?
lede: Brave like Harry, clever like Hermione or dreamy like Luna? Answer 12 questions about school, friends and trouble to find your match at Hogwarts.
about: The Harry Potter stories are full of characters readers recognize in themselves: Harry's courage and loyalty, Hermione's brains and sense of fairness, Ron's humor and big heart, Luna's calm oddness, Neville's quiet bravery, Draco's pride and ambition, Ginny's fire and confidence, and Dumbledore's wisdom and secrets. This quiz matches you with one of these eight.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. Want your house too? Try the Hogwarts house quiz and the Patronus quiz on this site. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by J.K. Rowling, Warner Bros. or Wizarding World; the names belong to their owners.

faq.a: Harry Potter, Hermione Granger, Ron Weasley, Luna Lovegood, Neville Longbottom, Draco Malfoy, Ginny Weasley and Albus Dumbledore.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every character appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: Is this the same as the Hogwarts house quiz?
faq.a: No. The house quiz sorts you into Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw or Slytherin; this one matches you with a single character.
No. It is a free fan quiz, and your answers stay in your browser.

harry.name: Harry Potter
harry.body: You are brave, loyal and quick to stand up for others, even when it gets you into trouble. You don't love the spotlight, but you step forward when it counts, and your friends know you'd do anything for them. Trust the people around you; you don't have to carry everything alone.

hermione.name: Hermione Granger
hermione.body: You are clever, hard-working and fiercely fair. You prepare for everything, you care about doing the right thing and you're the one who finds the answer when everyone else is stuck. Let yourself relax sometimes; you're more than your grades.

ron.name: Ron Weasley
ron.body: You are funny, warm and loyal to the end. You may doubt yourself, but you're braver than you think, and your jokes keep your friends going through hard times. Remember that being the one who shows up matters as much as being the one in the spotlight.

luna.name: Luna Lovegood
luna.body: You are calm, kind and wonderfully yourself. You notice things others miss, you don't care much what people think and you say true things at unexpected moments. Your openness makes others feel they can be themselves too.

neville.name: Neville Longbottom
neville.body: You are gentle, loyal and much braver than you look. You may be quiet and unsure at first, but you grow when it matters and stand up for what's right, even to your friends. Your courage is the quiet kind that lasts.

draco.name: Draco Malfoy
draco.body: You are ambitious, sharp and stylish, and you care about where you come from. You can seem proud or cold, but there's more going on under the surface than people think. Your drive is real; choose your own path instead of the one others expect.

ginny.name: Ginny Weasley
ginny.body: You are bold, funny and confident, with a fiery side nobody should test. You grew out of being overlooked and into someone who speaks up, plays hard and knows her own mind. Your confidence lifts the people around you.

dumbledore.name: Albus Dumbledore
dumbledore.body: You are wise, curious and a little mysterious. You love learning, you see the big picture and you guide people gently rather than telling them what to do. You have a soft spot for sweets and silly things, and people come to you when they're lost.
